instruction: Navigate to the forms page for the National Security Division on the Department of Justice website.

metadata.explanation: This task variation asks the agent to navigate to the National Security Division forms page on justice.gov. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'forms?title=&field_component_target_id=476' using the existing is_expected_url_pattern_match function. The task maintains the same structure and difficulty as the original Civil Division task, only changing the target division (component ID 476 instead of 431).

llm_judge_reasons: The getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from the Chrome accessibility tree
The metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
The expected pattern 'forms\?title=&field_component_target_id=476' correctly identifies the National Security Division forms page (component ID 476)
The evaluator checks all requirements: presence of 'forms' in URL and correct query parameters with the right component ID
The regex pattern is correctly escaped in JSON (\? becomes \? in regex to match literal '?')
The evaluator logic will successfully verify whether the user navigated to the correct forms page
